Description.Name: Visor Strike Vehicle
Description.Details: The A configuration of the Visor Strike Vehicle mounts a Clan LRM-15 with an Artemis V attachment in the turret and a Clan Large Pulse Laser in the front. This loadout is meant to provide accurate fire support while limiting the damage caused by stray fire. As with every Visor, the weapons stay hidden behind the bodywork of a civilian Puller truck until the crew reveals them. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 155 20 Left 110 20 Right 110 20 Rear 110 20 Turret 110 20 Total 595 100 Quirk: Easy to Maintain Can Resupply/Repair

YangsThoughts: You'd never pick it out of traffic, Boss, because it looks just like a Puller, the civilian trailer truck nearly every industrial world builds. The Society wanted its undercover intervention teams to have heavy weapons close at hand, so the turret's tucked into the worker compartment behind the cab and the rest of the guns stay covered until the crew needs them. Underneath, though, it's no truck. They gave it a bigger XL fusion engine and thicker Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor, so small arms won't bother it much, and with thirteen tons of pod space it can handle most support jobs.
